era: 1736 年 1 月 19 日生于苏格兰格里诺克一个造船匠与商人家庭，幼年体弱多病多由母亲在家中授课——少年时在父亲的作坊里学会了木工与使用工具，15 岁两读格拉夫桑德的《自然哲学原理》——1754 年赴伦敦学仪器制造，一年内学完通常四年的学徒课程——1756 年回到格拉斯哥，因未完成正式学徒身份遭行会刁难，转机来自格拉斯哥大学收到的一批需要修理的天文仪器（Macfarlane 遗赠）：修好后 1757 年获聘大学'数学仪器制造师'，在校内设工作室，结识化学家约瑟夫·布莱克与青年化学家罗比森——1761-1762 年用帕潘消化器做高压蒸汽实验，因锅炉爆炸风险而搁置——1763-1764 年冬，安德森教授请他修理一台供自然哲学课演示用的纽科门机模型：模型能转但耗汽惊人——他没有止步于'修好'，而是追问蒸汽到底在哪里被浪费：先测出小汽缸按比例暴露更大的冷凝面，再以布莱克的潜热概念为参照，自己在药房小瓶里重做量热实验独立求出汽化潜热——1765 年 5 月一个星期日在格拉斯哥绿地上散步时想出分离冷凝器：让汽缸始终热着、让冷凝在另一个永远冷的容器里发生，'1 或 2 天之内发明在我脑中已完成'——1769 年 1 月 5 日获专利《减少火机中蒸汽与燃料消耗的新方法》；与罗巴克合作在凯尼尔建样机，因加工精度与资金双重受困，1773 年罗巴克破产后其专利份额转让给伯明翰制造商博尔顿——1775 年合组 Boulton & Watt 并促成议会把专利延至 1800 年；1776 年首批机器投产，康沃尔铜矿成为最大市场——1774 年威尔金森的精密镗缸机解决了困扰五年的活塞密封问题；1781 年为绕开皮卡德的曲柄专利，默多克的行星轮方案以瓦特名义获专利——1782 年双动式与蒸汽扩展做功专利（'vacuum 路径'与'蒸汽直接做功'并陈，但瓦特判断低压蒸汽下扩展做功收益甚微而主动搁置）——1784 年他最得意的平行运动连杆——1780 年湿纸复制机专利（订阅者包括富兰克林、华盛顿、韦奇伍德、斯米顿）——1780 年代以'马力'为计量单位、按节省燃料的三分之一收取特许费，康沃尔'每一蒲式耳煤的英尺磅功'（duty）成为行业标尺——1785 年起用玻璃瓶观察汽缸内蒸汽状态，后与雇员约翰·萨瑟恩做出蒸汽指示仪与指示图，成为此后一百年热力学与工程诊断的核心工具——1790 年代与霍恩布洛尔复合机、布尔上冲机的专利诉讼连胜，1799 年判决确立'分离冷凝器'垄断，也使高压蒸汽路线被压制到 1800 年专利期满——1795 年建 Soho 铸造厂实现发动机整机制造，1800 年 41 台——1800 年退休后在汉兹沃思家中的阁楼工作室继续发明：雕塑复制车床、测湿仪、改进的复制机；他独立提出水由'可燃空气'与'脱燃素空气'化合而成（1783 年致普里斯特利信），卷入与卡文迪什、拉瓦锡的水组成之争——1819 年 8 月 25 日去世；功率单位'瓦特'以他命名。
era_en: Born 19 January 1736 in Greenock, Scotland, to a shipwright-merchant family; sickly as a child and taught largely at home — learned woodworking and the use of tools in his father's workshop, read 's Gravesande's Elements of Natural Philosophy twice at fifteen — in 1754 went to London to learn instrument-making, compressing a four-year apprenticeship into one year — returned to Glasgow in 1756, blocked by the guild for lacking a formal apprenticeship, rescued by the University of Glasgow's need for a batch of Macfarlane-bequeathed astronomical instruments to be repaired: restored, he was appointed 'mathematical instrument maker to the University' in 1757 with a workshop on campus, meeting the chemist Joseph Black and the young John Robison — in 1761-62 experimented on high-pressure steam with a Papin's digester, then set it aside for fear of bursting boilers — in the winter of 1763-64 Professor John Anderson had him repair a model Newcomen engine used for lecture demonstrations: it ran but consumed an astonishing amount of steam — he did not stop at 'fixed', asking where exactly the steam was wasted: measured that the small cylinder exposed proportionally more condensing surface, then, using Black's concept as a reference, redid the calorimetry himself in apothecaries' phials and independently recovered the latent heat of vaporisation — on a Sunday stroll on Glasgow Green in May 1765 the separate condenser came to him: keep the cylinder always hot, do the condensing in another vessel kept permanently cold, 'in the course of one or two days the invention was thus far complete in my mind' — patent granted 5 January 1769, 'A new method of lessening the consumption of steam and fuel in fire-engines'; a prototype at Kinneil with John Roebuck stalled on both machining precision and money, and on Roebuck's 1773 bankruptcy his share passed to the Birmingham manufacturer Matthew Boulton — the Boulton & Watt partnership of 1775 secured a parliamentary extension of the patent to 1800; first engines in 1776, with the Cornish copper mines the largest market — in 1774 John Wilkinson's precision boring machine ended five years of piston-sealing frustration; in 1781, to skirt Pickard's crank patent, Murdoch's sun-and-planet gear was patented in Watt's name — in 1782 the double-acting engine and expansive-working patent (steam force used directly as well as vacuum, though Watt judged expansive working near-worthless at his low pressures and deliberately shelved it) — 1784 the parallel motion linkage he was proudest of — 1780 the damp-paper copying-press patent (subscribers included Franklin, Washington, Wedgwood, Smeaton) — through the 1780s the 'horsepower' unit priced royalties at a third of the fuel saved, and Cornwall's 'duty' (foot-pounds per bushel of coal) became the industry's yardstick — from 1785 glass-vessel observations of steam inside the working cylinder, then, with his employee John Southern, the steam indicator and indicator diagram, the central diagnostic tool of engineering and thermodynamics for the next century — in the 1790s successful litigation against Hornblower's compound and Bull's upstroke engines established the separate-condenser monopoly in 1799, while suppressing the high-pressure line until the patent lapsed in 1800 — 1795 the Soho Foundry brought whole-engine manufacture in-house, 41 engines in 1800 — retired in 1800 to the garret workshop of his Handsworth house: a sculpture-copying lathe, a hygrometer, an improved copying press; he independently proposed that water is a compound of inflammable and dephlogisticated air (letter to Priestley, April 1783), entering the water-composition dispute with Cavendish and Lavoisier — died 25 August 1819; the SI unit of power, the watt, bears his name.
school: 蒸汽动力工程 / 精密仪器制造 / 热学（潜热与蒸汽性质）/ 工程测量与诊断 / 技术商业化
historical_significance: 把纽科门机从'能转的耗煤怪物'改造为通用动力源：以分离冷凝器使汽缸保持恒温，燃料消耗降为原来的约四分之一，蒸汽机第一次走出矿场进入工厂；他把'发明'做成一个系统工程——由定量的损耗审计（耗汽测量、潜热量热）定位症结，以诊断仪器（指示图）使工作过程可见，以标准单位（马力、duty）把效率变成可计价、可诉讼、可比较的货币，以精密制造（威尔金森镗缸）、专利经营与博尔顿式的分工联营把想法变成产业；约 500 台 Boulton & Watt 发动机、马力概念、平行运动、离心调速器与指示图，共同构成工业革命的动力基础设施——而他作为'修理者'起家、以'追问损耗在哪里'开路的方法论，是把工程问题转化为科学问题的原型。
historical_significance_en: Rebuilt Newcomen's engine from a coal-devouring pump that happened to run into a general-purpose power source: the separate condenser kept the cylinder at constant temperature and cut fuel consumption to roughly a quarter, letting the steam engine leave the mine for the factory; he made invention a systems engineering — locating the fault by quantitative loss audit (steam-consumption measurements, latent-heat calorimetry), making the working process visible with diagnostic instruments (the indicator diagram), turning efficiency into a priceable, litigable, comparable currency with standard units (horsepower, duty), and converting ideas into industry through precision manufacture (Wilkinson's boring machine), patent management and Boulton-style division of labour; some 500 Boulton & Watt engines, the concept of horsepower, the parallel motion, the centrifugal governor and the indicator diagram together form the power infrastructure of the Industrial Revolution — and his methodology, beginning as a repairer and opening with 'where exactly is the loss', is the prototype of turning an engineering problem into a scientific one.
unique_thinking: 瓦特的思维内核是'先量化损耗，再动手发明'：他接到修理纽科门机模型的任务，没有把'能转了'当作终点，而是追问一台每冲程喷入的冷水中有多大比例的热被用来加热自己刚刚冷却的汽缸——损耗被量化到'多少磅水当量'的精度之后，分离冷凝器不是灵感而是推论；他的第二个内核是'让互相冲突的职能分开住'：燃料经济性要求汽缸永远热，冷凝要求它每冲程被冷却——他不去调和这个矛盾，而是给两个要求各盖一栋房子（热的汽缸、冷的冷凝器），'解耦'而非'折中'成为解决冲突需求的基本动作；他坚持亲自动手验证学来的理论——布莱克的潜热他不知道，自己在药房小瓶里量了出来，事后与布莱克的对谈才把两条线接上，'潜热是我自己求出来的，用 药剂师的小瓶'（晚年对乌雷语）；他为'看不见的过程'造看得见的仪器：汽缸里的蒸汽到底在干什么，先以玻璃瓶观察，再由萨瑟恩做成指示仪——诊断先于治疗，而仪器的图（指示图）此后一百多年成了热力学本身；他对'什么时候不用一个好想法'同样清醒：蒸汽扩展做功已写进 1782 年专利，他判断自己低压体系下收益甚微便主动搁置，留给三十年后高压路线的特里维西克们；他把测量变成商业模式——马力是计价单位，'省下的燃料的三分之一'是价目表，duty 是行业标尺：使效率可比较，才使效率可出售。
unique_thinking_en: Watt's cognitive core is 'quantify the loss before you invent': given the job of repairing a model Newcomen engine, he did not treat 'it runs again' as the end, but asked what fraction of each stroke's injection water was spent reheating a cylinder the machine itself had just chilled — once the loss was quantified to pounds-of-water equivalents, the separate condenser was not a spark but an inference; his second core is 'give conflicting functions separate houses': fuel economy demands a cylinder always hot, condensation demands it chilled every stroke — he refused to split the difference and instead built each demand its own room, the hot cylinder and the permanently cold condenser, making decoupling rather than compromise the basic move against conflicting requirements; he insisted on verifying received theory with his own hands — ignorant of Black's latent heat he measured it himself in apothecaries' phials, the two lines joining only in later conversation ('I worked it out myself in the best way that I could... with apothecaries' phials', to Ure in old age); he built visible instruments for invisible processes: what the steam inside the cylinder was doing he first watched through a glass vessel, then John Southern turned into the indicator — diagnosis before treatment, and the diagram itself became thermodynamics for the next century; he was equally clear about when not to use a good idea: expansive working was already in his 1782 patent, but judging its gain negligible at his low pressures he deliberately shelved it for the high-pressure men thirty years on; and he turned measurement into a business model — horsepower the pricing unit, 'one third of the fuel saved' the tariff, duty the industry's yardstick: only efficiency made comparable can be sold.
civilization_zh: 苏格兰启蒙运动：格拉斯哥大学'以教养养工匠'的独特生态（布莱克、亚当·斯密、罗比森的同廊而过）、长老会商人家庭的动手传统与实用精神、月社（Lunar Society）的科学家-制造商联盟、专利制度与议会游说所代表的英国产权政治、苏格兰-英格兰之间的工程师劳动力市场
civilization_en: The Scottish Enlightenment: a university ecosystem that kept craftsmen on campus (Black, Adam Smith, Robison within the same corridor), the hands-on practicality of a Covenanter merchant family, the Lunar Society alliance of scientists and manufacturers, the property-rights politics of patent and Parliament, and the labour market for engineers that ran between Scotland and England
roles_zh: 仪器制造师；蒸汽机发明家与改良者；热学实验家；工程师-企业家（Boulton & Watt 合伙人）；测量与标准化先驱
roles_en: Instrument maker; inventor and improver of the steam engine; experimentalist in heat; engineer-entrepreneur (partner in Boulton & Watt); pioneer of measurement and standardisation

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/以定量损耗审计定位系统症结并推论解法
modes.domain_en: Methodology / locating a system's fault by quantitative loss audit and inferring the remedy
modes.definition_zh: 工程方法论/接到'让系统恢复工作'的任务时，不停留在恢复运转，而是先量化系统损失到底发生在哪里：修理纽科门机模型时他测出小汽缸按表面积/容积比暴露更大的冷凝面，再以潜热概念估算每个冲程喷入的冷水把多少热用来加热刚被自己冷却的汽缸——把'耗煤太多'翻译成'每冲程 X 磅水当量的热被白白烧掉'；损耗被量化到这个精度后，分离冷凝器不是灵感而是推论——'既然热量在再加热汽缸上流失，那就别让它流'；不量化的抱怨只是情绪，量化的抱怨才是设计输入
modes.definition_en: Engineering methodology: given the task 'make the system work again', do not stop at restoring operation — quantify first where the system's loss actually occurs: repairing the Newcomen model, he measured that the small cylinder exposed proportionally more condensing surface, then used the latent-heat concept to estimate how much heat from each stroke's injection water went into reheating the cylinder the machine itself had just chilled — translating 'burns too much coal' into 'the heat of X pounds of water wasted per stroke'; at that precision the separate condenser was not inspiration but inference — 'since heat is lost reheating the cylinder, do not let it be lost'; an unquantified complaint is only emotion, a quantified complaint is design input
modes.source_chapter: 瓦特晚年自述（穆尔黑德整理《罗伯特·哈特纪念演讲》引述）；罗比森《瓦特传》记载的 1763-64 修理过程
modes.key_quote_zh: 它转起来了，但每冲程要喝掉惊人的注入水——机器在自己的汽缸上取暖，我先把这笔账算清楚，再决定怎么盖房子。
modes.key_quote_en: It runs, but each stroke drinks an astonishing quantity of injection water — the machine warms itself on its own cylinder; I settled that account first, and only then decided how to build.
key_concepts: 损耗审计 the loss audit（把抱怨翻译成每冲程的热量当量）
比例效应 the scaling effect（模型缸的表面/容积比暴露大机看不到的缺陷）
症结先行 fault before fix（没算清的损失不配得到设计）
process_zh: 让系统'带病运转'并全程计量：修好模型只是起点，记录每冲程的注入水量、行程、负荷
把定性抱怨翻译为定量账目：'耗煤太多'→'每冲程多少热用于再加热汽缸'——单位统一为磅水当量
对照理论解释账目：用潜热与比热解释为什么小缸比大缸浪费得更凶——找出随尺度变化的项
由账目推论构造：既然损失在'冷缸加热'，解法就是'缸热不冷、冷凝外置'——设计是审计的自然推论
process_en: Run the system sick and meter it: repairing the model is the start, not the finish — log injection water, stroke, load per stroke
Translate the qualitative complaint into a quantitative account: 'burns too much coal' becomes 'this much heat per stroke spent reheating the cylinder', in pounds-of-water equivalents
Explain the account with theory: latent and specific heats explain why the small cylinder wastes worse than a big one — find the scale-dependent term
Infer the construction from the account: since the loss is 'heating a cold cylinder', the remedy is 'keep the cylinder hot, condense elsewhere' — design falls out of the audit
representative_cases_zh: 1763-64 纽科门机模型修理：模型能转但锅炉供不上汽——他测出小缸按比例暴露更大冷凝面，并以潜热算出每冲程的热账，两年的实验全部围绕这张账展开
分离冷凝器的推导：1765 年 5 月绿地散步的'灵感'，实为'热量不该在缸内冷凝'这条量化结论的直接推论——'1 或 2 天之内发明在我脑中已完成'，因为账早已算完
康沃尔矿区的 duty 审计：为按省煤收费，他建立'每蒲式耳煤产出英尺磅功'的机器账本，使每台发动机的损耗无处藏身
representative_cases_en: Repairing the Newcomen model, 1763-64: it ran but the boiler could not supply it — he measured the small cylinder's proportionally larger condensing surface and computed the per-stroke heat account, two years of experiments orbiting that account

Deriving the separate condenser: the 'spark' on Glasgow Green in May 1765 was the direct inference of the quantified conclusion 'heat must not condense inside the cylinder' — 'in the course of one or two days the invention was thus far complete in my mind', because the account was already done
The duty audit of Cornwall: to charge by fuel saved he built a ledger of foot-pounds of work per bushel of coal, leaving every engine's losses nowhere to hide
modern_applications_zh: 性能工程：任何优化之前先跑 profiling——把'感觉慢'变成火焰图上的函数级热账
成本诊断：企业经营不稳先做单位经济账（每单/每客/每台设备的损耗项），再谈战略
能效审计：建筑与数据中心的'损耗仪表化'——电表到机柜，热账到冲程
modern_applications_en: Performance engineering: profile before optimizing — turn 'feels slow' into a function-level heat map of where time goes
Cost diagnosis: before strategy talk, a unit-economics audit of any unstable business — loss items per order, per customer, per machine
Energy auditing: instrumenting losses in buildings and data centres — meters down to the rack, heat accounts down to the stroke

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/给互相冲突的功能需求各建独立构件而非折中调和
modes.domain_en: Methodology / giving conflicting functional requirements separate components instead of a compromise
modes.definition_zh: 系统设计方法论/当两个正当需求在同一构件上不可兼得时，不寻找折中点，而是把需求拆到两个独立构件上各自满足：燃料经济性要求汽缸永远保持蒸汽温度，冷凝做功要求它每冲程被冷却——纽科门机五十年里把这对矛盾硬塞在一个缸里，冷喷射水每冲程把汽缸打回冰点，下一个冲程再花大半燃料把它烧回来；瓦特的解法不是'少喷点水'或'缸壁加厚'这类调和，而是给两个要求各盖一栋房子——热的汽缸继续吸汽做功，冷的冷凝器专门承接冷凝，一根连通管把二者接通，蒸汽自己流向它该去的地方；冲突不被消灭，冲突被安排住处
modes.definition_en: Systems-design methodology: when two legitimate demands cannot both live on one component, do not look for the compromise point — split the demands across two independent components that each satisfy one: fuel economy wants the cylinder always at steam temperature, condensation wants it chilled every stroke — Newcomen's engine had crammed the pair into one cylinder for fifty years, the cold spray knocking the cylinder back to near-freezing each stroke and the next stroke burning most of the fuel to warm it again; Watt's answer was not 'spray less' or 'thicken the walls' but to build each demand its own house — the hot cylinder keeps taking steam and doing work, the cold condenser exists solely to receive the condensation, a communicating pipe joins them and the steam flows to where it belongs; the conflict is not abolished, it is housed
modes.source_chapter: 1769 年专利说明书第一、二条（'蒸汽容器在整个工作期间必须保持与进入的蒸汽一样热'/'蒸汽在与蒸汽容器分离的容器中冷凝'）
modes.key_quote_zh: 汽缸必须始终像进入它的蒸汽一样热，冷凝必须发生在与汽缸分开的容器里——两条原则，各住各的房子。
modes.key_quote_en: The steam vessel must be kept as hot as the steam that enters it, and the condensation must happen in a vessel distinct from the steam vessel — two principles, two houses.
key_concepts: 解耦 decoupling（冲突需求分构件安置，而非单构件折中）
中间态 保持 hot path 的完整性（缸体从建造到退役不再经历冷热循环）
连通室 the communicating vessel（蒸汽自动流向低压处——让物理而非控制器维持秩序）
process_zh: 把'做不好'改写成'两个需求在同一构件上打架'：列出每个需求各自的物理条件（缸要热、冷凝要冷）
确认折中不可行：算给折中看——缸壁每厚一分，冷凝每慢一分而升温每贵一分，调和曲线没有可行点
按需求设计独立构件：热屋（汽缸+蒸汽套）与冷屋（水浸冷凝器）各自按自己的物理条件建造
用最低限度的连接让系统自组织：一根连通管，蒸汽凭压差自动迁移——不加阀门逻辑，让物理规律做分配者
process_en: Rewrite 'it underperforms' as 'two demands fight on one component': list each demand's physical conditions (cylinder hot, condensation cold)
Show the compromise is infeasible: compute it — a thicker wall slows cooling but prices heating; the compromise curve has no feasible point
Design an independent component per demand: the hot house (cylinder plus steam jacket) and the cold house (water-immersed condenser), each built to its own physics
Let the system self-organise through a minimal connection: one communicating pipe, steam migrating by pressure difference — no valve logic, physics as the dispatcher
representative_cases_zh: 分离冷凝器 (1765)：热的汽缸与冷的冷凝器分居，燃料消耗降为纽科门机的约四分之一——工业史上最著名的一次'分家'
蒸汽套与汽缸盖 (1769-1782)：为保护'缸体常热'这栋房子，他又给汽缸加蒸汽套、加盖密封，把'漏热'的每条路径逐条堵死——解耦之后是体系化地守住解耦
行星轮齿轮 (1781)：曲柄被皮卡德专利占据时，他把'往复转旋转'与'曲柄机构'解耦——同一个功能需求，另建一栋合法的房子（太阳-行星啮合齿轮）
representative_cases_en: The separate condenser (1765): hot cylinder and cold condenser housed apart, fuel consumption down to about a quarter of Newcomen's — the most famous house-split in industrial history

The steam jacket and closed cylinder top (1769-82): to guard the 'cylinder always hot' house he jacketed the cylinder and sealed the top, sealing every leak path — after decoupling, systematically defending the decoupling

The sun-and-planet gear (1781): with the crank occupied by Pickard's patent, he decoupled 'reciprocation to rotation' from 'crank mechanism' — the same functional demand housed legally elsewhere, in meshed sun-and-planet gears
modern_applications_zh: 微服务架构：读写、冷热数据、计算存储分离——'分离冷凝器'是四十年后软件架构师的日常动词
组织设计：把'创新'与'运营'拆成两个单元各有 KPI，避免同一团队'既要稳又要闯'的折中内耗
芯片设计：性能核与能效核分工（异构多核）——热与冷的房子在同一块硅上
modern_applications_en: Microservice architecture: separating reads from writes, hot from cold data, compute from storage — 'the separate condenser' is a daily verb for software architects two centuries on
Organisational design: splitting innovation and operations into units with their own KPIs, ending the compromise burnout of one team told to be both steady and daring
Chip design: performance cores and efficiency cores dividing the labour (heterogeneous multi-core) — the hot house and the cold house on one piece of silicon
representative_figures: 瓦特（核心）
冯·诺依曼（潜在：计算与存储分离的架构先声）
康威（对照：组件应映射需求而非共用）

modes.domain_zh: 认识论/对关键概念亲自重做实验以获得可用的理解
modes.domain_en: Epistemology / re-doing the experiments behind a key concept yourself until you possess it
modes.definition_zh: 认识论方法论/对决定自己设计成败的科学概念，不接受'听说过'级别的理解，必须亲自重做一遍实验把它变成自己的：瓦特在算汽缸热账时需要潜热——水变成汽要额外吞多少热、汽变回水又要吐出来多少——他并不知道布莱克已在讲台上讲过这个概念，便用药剂师的小瓶当量热计，独立测出了汽化潜热的近似值；拿着自己的结果去见布莱克，两条独立的线在对话中接上；他晚年对乌雷强调'潜热是我自己求出来的，用药剂师的小瓶'——借来的理论只能借来结论，亲手重做的理论才给出能指导设计的直觉（数值在什么条件下变、哪个近似可以胆大）
modes.definition_en: Epistemological methodology: for the scientific concept your design's success hinges on, refuse 'I have heard of it' — redo the experiments yourself until you possess it: computing the cylinder's heat account, Watt needed latent heat — how much extra heat water swallows becoming steam and gives back condensing — unaware that Black had lectured on it for years, he used apothecaries' phials as calorimeters and independently measured an approximation of the latent heat of vaporisation; taking his own result to Black, the two independent lines joined in conversation; in old age he insisted to Ure, 'I worked it out myself in the best way that I could... I used apothecaries' phials for my apparatus' — a borrowed theory lends you conclusions, a theory re-done by hand gives you the intuition that guides design (where the numbers bend, which approximations you may dare)
modes.source_chapter: 乌雷在 1839 年格拉斯哥瓦特纪念碑会议上的证词（《博尔顿与瓦特传》第 8 章引）
modes.key_quote_zh: 潜热是必不可少的知识，是我自己用最好的办法求出来的——我的仪器是药剂师的小瓶。
modes.key_quote_en: The latent heat of steam was knowledge essential to my inquiries, and I worked it out myself in the best way that I could — my apparatus was apothecaries' phials.
key_concepts: 亲手重做 redo it by hand（理论要过一遍自己的手才能进设计）
最低仪器 the minimal instrument（小瓶当量热计——精度不足时用设计保量热）
双线对接 converging lines（独立得出的结果与专家对话时逐条校核）
process_zh: 列出设计依赖的概念清单，逐个标记'听过/做过'：潜热对瓦特是决定性的，必须从'听过'升级为'做过'
用最低成本的仪器重做实验：没有量热计就用小瓶、温度计和称量——仪器不足用设计与重复来补
拿自己的结果去找原创者对话：向布莱克复述自己的测法与数值，请他逐条挑错——对话是对账不是听课
把验证后的概念写进设计语言：潜热进入热账计算与冷凝器尺寸设计——概念完成从讲义到图纸的迁移
process_en: List the concepts your design depends on and tag each 'heard of' or 'done': latent heat was decisive for Watt and had to be upgraded from heard to done
Redo the experiment with the cheapest instrument that can serve: no calorimeter — phials, a thermometer, and weighing; make up for instruments with design and repetition
Take your own result to the originator for dialogue: recount your method and numbers to Black and let him fault them line by line — conversation as reconciliation, not lecture
Write the verified concept into your design language: latent heat enters the heat account and the condenser's sizing — the concept migrates from lecture notes to drawing board
representative_cases_zh: 药剂师小瓶里的潜热 (1764-65)：小瓶量热得出汽化潜热近似值，与布莱克对谈后接入热账——分离冷凝器的定量基础由此立住
水的组成之争 (1783)：他在致普里斯特利的信中独立论证'可燃空气+脱燃素空气→水'，与卡文迪什、拉瓦锡并立的第三条独立路线——即使结论错了路线也是自己的
蒸汽性质表：他系统测定不同温度下水的蒸汽压，早于克拉佩龙——为扩展做功的取舍提供自己的数据底座
representative_cases_en: Latent heat in apothecaries' phials (1764-65): phial calorimetry yielded an approximation of the latent heat of vaporisation, joined to the heat account after talking with Black — the quantitative foundation of the separate condenser

The water-composition dispute (1783): his letter to Priestley independently argued 'inflammable air + dephlogisticated air → water', a third route beside Cavendish and Lavoisier — a route of one's own even where the conclusion was contested
The properties of steam: he systematically tabulated the vapour pressure of water at various temperatures, before Clapeyron — his own data floor for the expansive-working decision
modern_applications_zh: 工程师读论文：关键结论必须在最小数据集上复现一次，'复现过的引用'与'转述的引用'是两种引用
团队知识管理：核心机制文档之外必须有人'能从零搭一遍'——听过与做过的差距就是事故的差距
个人学习：以'自己重做关键实验'为学习完成判据，而非以'读过'为完成
modern_applications_en: Engineers reading papers: reproduce the key result once on a minimal dataset — a citation you have reproduced and one you have paraphrased are different citations
Team knowledge management: beyond the mechanism doc, someone must be able to rebuild it from zero — the gap between heard and done is the gap between incident and no incident
Personal learning: completion is 'I re-did the key experiment', not 'I read it'
representative_figures: 瓦特（核心）
约瑟夫·布莱克（对话方：原创者与校核者）
理查德·费曼（潜在：'不能重新推导就不算懂'的同宗）

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/为看不见的工作过程建造记录仪器使诊断成为可能
modes.domain_en: Methodology / building recording instruments for invisible working processes so diagnosis becomes possible
modes.definition_zh: 实验方法论/当系统的核心过程发生在看不见的封闭空间里，诊断只能靠猜时，就为它造一台'显影'仪器：汽缸里的蒸汽在每一冲程里到底处于什么状态——压力多少、冷凝多少、损失在哪——从外面完全看不见；1785 年瓦特先以玻璃瓶接在汽缸上观察蒸汽的凝结行为，再由雇员约翰·萨瑟恩把'压力随容积变化'画成自动记录——蒸汽指示仪与指示图由此诞生：一根小汽缸贴着主缸，弹簧驱动划笔，纸上留下封闭的功图曲线；图上每一处凹陷都是一处损耗，'看见'先于'修好'；这张图此后一百多年是蒸汽工程师的听诊器，也是热力学（克劳修斯、克佩龙对卡诺循环的图形分析）的形式语言
modes.definition_en: Experimental methodology: when a system's core process happens inside an invisible closed space and diagnosis is guesswork, build it a revealing instrument: what state the steam was in during each stroke — pressure, condensation, where the loss sat — could not be seen from outside; in 1785 Watt first watched the steam's condensing behaviour through a glass vessel tied to the cylinder, then his employee John Southern turned 'pressure versus volume' into an automatic record — the steam indicator and its diagram: a small cylinder strapped to the main one, a spring-driven pencil, a closed work loop left on paper; every dent in the loop is a loss, and seeing precedes fixing; for over a century the diagram was the steam engineer's stethoscope and the formal language of thermodynamics (Clausius and Clapeyron's graphical analysis of the Carnot cycle)
modes.source_chapter: 卡文迪什 1785 年 8 月参观 Soho 的目击记录；《 19 世纪蒸汽指示器史》（ Newcomen Society 论文）
modes.key_quote_zh: 有些蒸汽在缸内就被冷凝了，虽然缸外全是蒸汽——我想知道它到底在什么时候、在哪里损失，于是让它在玻璃里向我招供。
modes.key_quote_en: Some steam condenses inside the cylinder though surrounded by steam — I wanted to know exactly when and where it was lost, so I made it confess in glass.
key_concepts: 显影仪器 the revealing instrument（把不可见过程转成可见记录）
压力-容积图 the p-V diagram（功图上每个凹陷对应一处损耗）
听诊器原则 the stethoscope principle（诊断工具独立于治疗工具）
process_zh: 识别'不可见且靠猜'的过程：汽缸内每冲程的状态变化——找出系统里最贵的未知量
先做定性观察装置：玻璃瓶接缸观察凝结——先确认现象存在与大概位置
再做定量记录仪器：与萨瑟恩合作把压力-容积关系自动画在纸上——观察升级为证据
把图读成诊断书：功图面积=输出功，凹陷=损耗；按图调阀调压——仪器的图直接指导操作
process_en: Identify the invisible, guessed-at process: the state changes inside the cylinder each stroke — find the system's most expensive unknown
Build the qualitative viewer first: a glass vessel on the cylinder to watch condensation — confirm the phenomenon and its rough location
Then build the quantitative recorder: with Southern, draw pressure against volume automatically on paper — observation upgraded to evidence
Read the diagram as a diagnosis: loop area is work out, dents are losses; tune valves and pressure by the diagram — the instrument's picture directly steers operation
representative_cases_zh: 1785 年玻璃瓶实验：卡文迪什与布拉格登到访 Soho 时目睹——瓦特以玻璃瓶让缸内蒸汽的凝结'当场招供'
指示仪与指示图 (约 1796，与约翰·萨瑟恩)：弹簧划笔在纸上画出功图——Boulton & Watt 的装配工凭图调整每一台出厂机器
热力学的形式语言：克劳修斯与克佩龙以指示图分析卡诺循环——一台诊断仪器长成了一门学科的工作语言
representative_cases_en: The glass-vessel experiment (1785): witnessed by Cavendish and Blagden visiting Soho — Watt made the cylinder's inner condensation confess in glass
The indicator and diagram (c. 1796, with John Southern): a spring-driven pencil drew the work loop — Boulton & Watt erectors tuned every shipped engine by its picture
The formal language of thermodynamics: Clausius and Clapeyron analysed the Carnot cycle on the indicator diagram — a diagnostic instrument grew into a discipline's working language
modern_applications_zh: 可观测性工程：metrics/logging/tracing 就是数字系统的'指示图'——生产环境里每个凹陷都是一次预算内的损耗
医学诊断影像：从听诊器到 MRI，'让看不见的过程显影'是临床医学的元方法
性能分析：火焰图、性能计数器、总线分析仪——先让过程可见，再谈优化
modern_applications_en: Observability engineering: metrics, logging and tracing are the digital system's indicator diagram — every dent in production is a loss with a line item
Medical imaging: from stethoscope to MRI, 'make the invisible process visible' is clinical medicine's meta-method
Profiling: flame graphs, hardware counters, bus analysers — visibility first, optimisation second
representative_figures: 瓦特（核心）
约翰·萨瑟恩（合作者：指示仪的具体实现者）
欧拉/克佩龙（潜在：把图变成学科语言的后继者）

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/以标准度量单位把效率变成可计价、可比较、可出售的商品
modes.domain_en: Methodology / turning efficiency into a priceable, comparable, sellable commodity with standard units
modes.definition_zh: 技术商业化方法论/当你的产品是'比别人省'时，必须先造出使'省'可测量、可比较、可计价的标尺：瓦特没有停留在'我的机器省煤'这句广告，而是发明了'马力'（33000 英尺·磅/分钟）作为功率的标准单位，以'每马力每年 5 英镑'计价；在康沃尔矿区，他的机器按'省下燃料的三分之一'收取特许费——这要求对每台机器、每种煤建立'每蒲式耳煤产出多少英尺磅功'的 duty 账本，duty 从此成为行业能效标尺；标尺先于交易：没有一个双方都认的度量，'省'就只是卖方的口头禅；标准单位同时是商业工具、工程工具与法律证据
modes.definition_en: Commercialisation methodology: when your product is 'less than the other fellow', first build the yardstick that makes the saving measurable, comparable and priceable: Watt did not stop at the advertisement 'my engine burns less coal' — he invented 'horsepower' (33,000 foot-pounds per minute) as the standard unit of power, priced at £5 per horsepower per year; in Cornwall his engines were charged at one third of the fuel they saved — which required a duty ledger, foot-pounds of work per bushel of coal, for every engine and every coal, and duty became the industry's efficiency yardstick; the standard before the transaction: without a measure both parties accept, 'saving' is only the seller's phrase; the standard unit is at once a commercial instrument, an engineering tool and a legal exhibit
modes.source_chapter: 《康沃尔蒸汽机》duty 记录与 Boulton & Watt 特许费账目 (1780s)
modes.key_quote_zh: 顾客买的不是机器，是省下的煤——而要让'省下的煤'能开票，得先让全世界同意一马力是多少。
modes.key_quote_en: The customer buys not the engine but the coal it saves — and before 'coal saved' can be invoiced, the world must first agree on what a horsepower is.
key_concepts: 马力 horsepower（33000 英尺·磅/分钟——把动力变成标准单位）
duty the duty（每蒲式耳煤的英尺磅功——行业能效标尺）
绩效计价 performance pricing（省下的燃料三分之一——供应商与客户利益绑定）
process_zh: 把产品价值翻译成一个可测的物理量：'省煤'→'等量功所耗燃料之差'——价值必须落到仪器能读的量上
定义标准单位并公开：马力=33000 英尺·磅/分钟——单位一旦定义就写进合同与账本，成为公共标尺
设计绑定绩效的计价结构：按省下燃料的 1/3 收特许费——我多省你才多付，激励与交付同向
为争议预留仲裁标尺：duty 账本由双方认可的方法测量——标准单位同时是诉讼中的证据格式
process_en: Translate the product's value into one measurable physical quantity: 'saves coal' becomes 'the fuel difference for equal work' — value must land where an instrument can read it
Define and publish the standard unit: one horsepower = 33,000 foot-pounds per minute — once defined it goes into contracts and ledgers as the public yardstick
Design a performance-bound price: a royalty of one third of the fuel saved — you pay more only when I save more, incentives and delivery aligned
Reserve an arbitration yardstick for disputes: duty measured by an agreed method — the standard unit doubles as the evidentiary format in litigation
representative_cases_zh: 马力与'每马力每年 5 英镑' (1784 起)：发动机第一次有了可开票的功率单位——Boulton & Watt 的价目表建立在自造的单位上
康威尔特许费体系：'省下燃料的 1/3'按 duty 账本结算——康沃尔矿主为压低特许费反而推动了全行业的能效军备竞赛
duty 成为行业标尺：早期瓦特机 duty 约 2000 万英尺·磅/蒲式耳，后继 Cornish 机推到 3000 万以上——标准单位在专利过期后仍统治行业话语
representative_cases_en: Horsepower at £5 per hp per year (from 1784): power gained an invoiceable unit — Boulton & Watt's price list built on a unit of their own making
The Cornwall royalty system: 'one third of the fuel saved' settled on the duty ledger — mine owners pushing the royalty down drove an industry-wide efficiency arms race

Duty as the industry's yardstick: early Watt engines near 20 million foot-pounds per bushel, later Cornish engines past 30 million — the standard unit ruled industry discourse long after the patent lapsed
modern_applications_zh: SaaS 定价：以'节省的工时/服务器成本'计价的价值定价模型——先造度量再谈价格
云服务基准：benchmark 分数成为采购合同条款——标尺即商业语言
碳交易：每吨 CO2 当量的定价——现代版的 duty 账本
modern_applications_en: SaaS value pricing: charging per engineer-hour or server-hour saved — build the measure before the price
Cloud benchmarking: benchmark scores written into procurement contracts — the yardstick is the commercial language
Carbon trading: pricing per tonne of CO2 equivalent — the duty ledger's modern edition

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/识别设计中最贵的加工瓶颈并引进外部专长加以击破
modes.domain_en: Methodology / identifying the design's most expensive manufacturing bottleneck and breaking it with outside expertise
modes.definition_zh: 工程产业化方法论/设计走不通时先给'堵点'分类：是原理不通还是工艺不通——瓦特的分离冷凝器原理 1765 年就立住了，真正卡死他五年的是工艺：蒸汽机要在热缸上保持效率，活塞必须在不靠水封的条件下与缸体紧密贴合，而当时没有任何车间能镗出足够精确的大直径汽缸——斯米顿对工程师学会的判词是'既没有工具也没有工人能以足够的精度制造这样复杂的机器'；瓦特试了五年失败，直到 1774 年威尔金森发明两端支撑镗杆的镗缸机，瓦特立刻把它引进自己的工艺链——瓶颈在别人的领域时，最短路径是把那个领域的人变成自己人，而不是自己再学一门手艺
modes.definition_en: Industrialisation methodology: when the design stalls, classify the blocker first — is it principle or process — Watt's separate condenser stood as principle in 1765; what pinned him for five years was process: for the engine to keep its efficiency on a hot cylinder, the piston had to seal tight without a water seal, and no workshop could bore a sufficiently precise large cylinder — Smeaton's verdict to the Society of Engineers: 'neither the tools nor the workmen existed who could manufacture such a complex machine with sufficient precision'; Watt tried for five years and failed, until in 1774 John Wilkinson invented a boring machine with the cutter shaft supported at both ends through the cylinder — and Watt immediately pulled it into his process chain; when the bottleneck lives in someone else's domain, the shortest path is to make that person's domain your own supply chain, not to learn a second trade
modes.source_chapter: 约瑟夫·威克姆·罗《蒸汽机与蒸汽船史》(1916) 记斯米顿判词；威尔金森镗缸机 (1774)
modes.key_quote_zh: 我的设计在图纸上已经完整了五年——直到威尔金森的镗床出现，纸上的机器才第一次有了能住进去的汽缸。
modes.key_quote_en: My design had been complete on paper for five years — only when Wilkinson's boring machine appeared did the engine on paper first get a cylinder it could live in.
key_concepts: 堵点分类 blocker triage（原理瓶颈自己攻，工艺瓶颈找外援）
精度即性能 precision as performance（缸体公差直接决定燃料经济性）
专长引进 expertise import（把外部突破变成自己供应链的一环）
process_zh: 把失败按'原理/工艺/资金'分类：1765-1774 的反复失败被诊断为工艺问题——原理早已被样机验证
找出瓶颈的物理指标并公示：活塞与缸体间隙——把'需要多准'说清楚，别人才知道能不能接
扫描行业里最接近该指标的人：威尔金森的镗炮筒精度是全英国离目标最近的
以合同锁定外援并保持自己的验收权：Boulton & Watt 二十年的汽缸几乎全部由威尔金森独家供应，但装配与验收标准在瓦特手里
process_en: Classify the failure as principle, process, or money: the 1765-74 failures were diagnosed as process — the principle already proven on the model
Publish the bottleneck's physical metric: the piston-to-cylinder clearance — state how precise it must be so others know whether they can take the job
Scan the industry for whoever comes nearest that metric: Wilkinson's cannon-boring precision was the closest in Britain

Lock the outside expert in by contract and keep acceptance on your side: for twenty years Wilkinson supplied nearly every cylinder exclusively, while assembly and acceptance standards stayed in Watt's hands
representative_cases_zh: 威尔金森镗缸机 (1774)：两端支撑镗杆镗出的大缸让活塞终于密封——1774 年凯尼尔样机搬到 Soho 后很快正常运转，'用威尔金森镗的缸'
斯米顿判词的利用：'没有工具也没有工人'——瓦特以此说服合作者与议会：这不是渐进改良而是全新产业
独家供应与专利延长的组合：博尔顿以威尔金森供应+议会延长专利到 1800 年双管齐下，把工艺瓶颈转化为商业护城河
representative_cases_en: Wilkinson's boring machine (1774): the two-end-supported boring bar produced a cylinder the piston could finally seal — the Kinneil engine, moved to Soho, soon ran properly 'with a cylinder bored by Wilkinson'
Working Smeaton's verdict: 'neither the tools nor the workmen existed' — Watt used it to persuade partners and Parliament that this was a new industry, not an incremental improvement
The exclusive-supply-plus-extension combination: Boulton paired Wilkinson's supply with the parliamentary extension to 1800, converting a process bottleneck into a commercial moat
modern_applications_zh: 芯片产业：设计公司与代工厂的分工——苹果设计、台积电制程，瓶颈在制程就投资制程
创业公司：核心算法自研、算力上云——把非瓶颈环节外包，把瓶颈环节变成护城河
开源协作：识别自己不擅长的基础组件（数据库/编译器），直接采用社区最优解
modern_applications_en: The chip industry: design houses and foundries — Apple designs, TSMC does process; when the bottleneck is process, invest in process
Startups: build the core algorithm in-house, rent compute from the cloud — outsource non-bottlenecks, turn the bottleneck into the moat
Open-source collaboration: for foundational components you do not excel at (databases, compilers), adopt the community's best

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/当最优路径被外部约束封死时，构造次优但合法的替代路径并保全功能
modes.domain_en: Methodology / when the optimal path is legally blocked, construct a second-best legal path that preserves the function
modes.definition_zh: 工程与法律交叉方法论/当通往功能的最短路径被法律或规则（专利、标准、准入）封锁，不去闯关也不放弃功能，而是寻找功能等价的替代构造：1781 年瓦特想用曲柄把往复运动转成旋转运动，但曲柄已被皮卡德的专利占据——他的团队没有绕道侵权，也没有放弃'旋转动力'这个目标，而是发明了行星轮齿轮（太阳轮固定、行星轮沿其滚动，输出轴反转）：功能保留，路径另辟；他同时清醒地知道这是次优解——1794 年皮卡德专利期满，Boulton & Watt 立刻换回曲柄；替代不是终点，是约束期内的临时居所
modes.definition_en: A methodology at the crossroads of engineering and law: when the shortest path to a function is blocked by law or rule (patent, standard, licence), neither trespass nor abandon the function — find a functionally equivalent alternative construction: in 1781 Watt wanted a crank to turn reciprocation into rotation, but the crank was held by Pickard's patent — his team neither trespassed nor gave up on 'rotary power', but invented the sun-and-planet gear (fixed sun wheel, planet wheel rolling around it, output shaft counter-rotating): function preserved, path rerouted; and he knew it was second-best — in 1794, Pickard's patent expired, Boulton & Watt switched back to the crank at once; the substitute is not the destination, it is lodging for the duration of the constraint
modes.source_chapter: 瓦特 1781 年 10 月行星轮专利；默多克与行星轮发明权的记载
modes.key_quote_zh: 曲柄住着别人的专利，但'让机器转起来'不是任何人的专利——我给功能另盖一栋合法的房子，期限以他人的专利为准。
modes.key_quote_en: The crank lives in someone else's patent, but 'make the machine turn' belongs to no one — I built the function another legal house, on a lease ending with another man's patent.
key_concepts: 功能-路径分离 function-path separation（目标不可谈判，路径可选）
次优解的时间戳 timestamped second-best（替代方案自带'约束期满即替换'的退场条款）
约束地图 the constraint map（先列出谁握着什么权利，再设计路径）
process_zh: 把目标写成功能而非构造：'提供旋转动力'而非'用曲柄'——功能是目标，构造只是候选路径
绘制约束地图：列出封锁最优路径的全部权利（皮卡德曲柄专利、自己的低压专利边界）
在约束地图的空白处寻找等价构造：行星轮齿轮在曲柄专利的权利要求之外实现同一功能
给替代方案设置退场条款：1794 年皮卡德专利一到期即换回曲柄——约束一消失，次优解即退役
process_en: Write the goal as a function, not a construction: 'provide rotary power', not 'use a crank' — the function is the goal, the construction merely a candidate path
Draw the constraint map: list every right blocking the optimal path (Pickard's crank patent, the boundary of one's own low-pressure patent)
Search the map's blank spaces for an equivalent construction: the sun-and-planet gear achieved the same function outside the crank patent's claims
Attach an exit clause to the substitute: when Pickard's patent expired in 1794 the crank returned at once — the constraint gone, the second-best retires
representative_cases_zh: 行星轮齿轮 (1781)：以瓦特名义获专利（方案多被认为出自默多克之手）——约束期内旋转动力照常交付
1794 年换回曲柄：皮卡德专利一过期，Boulton & Watt 立刻采用经济与技术上更优的曲柄+飞轮——替代方案的退场被提前写好
1798-1799 专利诉讼：对霍恩布洛尔复合机的胜诉使'分离冷凝器'成为任何竞争者绕不开的约束——瓦特同时是替身建造者与设障者
representative_cases_en: The sun-and-planet gear (1781): patented in Watt's name (the scheme widely credited to Murdoch) — rotary power delivered on schedule through the constraint period
Switching back to the crank (1794): the moment Pickard's patent lapsed, Boulton & Watt adopted the economically and technically superior crank plus flywheel — the substitute's exit pre-written
The 1798-99 litigation: winning against Hornblower's compound made the separate condenser a constraint no competitor could skirt — Watt was simultaneously builder of substitutes and placer of blocks
modern_applications_zh: 标准必要专利应对：设计-around（规避设计）——在权利要求之外寻找功能等价实现
技术选型：开源协议合规路线（GPL 不兼容时换 MIT 替代库），并预留'政策一变即回切'的方案
产品出海：被某国市场准入卡住时，以功能等价的产品形态走另一条合规通道
modern_applications_en: Dealing with standard-essential patents: design-around — a functionally equivalent implementation outside the claims
Technology selection: licence-compliant routing (swap a GPL-incompatible library for an MIT one), with a plan to switch back when policy changes
Market entry: when one country's access rules block you, take a functionally equivalent product form through another compliance lane

modes.domain_zh: 商业方法论/以法定垄断把技术优势转化为长期现金流并压制竞争
modes.domain_en: Business methodology / converting technical advantage into long-term cash flow and competitive suppression through legal monopoly
modes.definition_zh: 技术商业化方法论/把发明不只变成产品，而是变成一份可以收租、可以续期、可以诉讼的产权：瓦特 1769 年取得分离冷凝器专利，1775 年借博尔顿的议会关系促成专利延长 25 年至 1800 年——此后二十五年的主业不是造机器而是'授权'：按省煤三分之一收取特许费，拒发许可证使竞争者无法使用冷凝器原理；1790 年代对霍恩布洛尔复合机与布尔上冲机的诉讼连胜，1799 年判决确认'任何使用分离冷凝器的发动机都侵权'——技术优势变成法律护城河；但这个模式同时压制了高压蒸汽路线十六年，专利期内效率几乎停滞、专利一过即爆炸式改进——收租者本人也被租金困住：守成优于创新，诉讼多于实验
modes.definition_en: Commercialisation methodology: make the invention not merely a product but a property that collects rent, renews, and litigates: Watt patented the separate condenser in 1769; in 1775, on Boulton's parliamentary connections, the patent was extended twenty-five years to 1800 — the next quarter-century's main business was not building engines but licensing: a royalty of one third of the fuel saved, licences refused so rivals could not touch the condenser principle; in the 1790s successful suits against Hornblower's compound and Bull's upstroke engines ended with the 1799 ruling that any engine using a separate condenser infringed — technical advantage became a legal moat; but the same model suppressed the high-pressure line for sixteen years, efficiency nearly frozen inside the patent and exploding the moment it lapsed — and the rentier is trapped by his own rent: conservation over innovation, litigation over experiment
modes.source_chapter: 1775 年专利延长法案；1799 年霍恩布洛尔案判决；博尔丁与莱文《反对知识垄断》对瓦特案的经济学分析
modes.key_quote_zh: 我的专利覆盖一切形式的火机——这句话在法庭上替我省下了三十年，也在实验室里替我省下了十六年的进步。
modes.key_quote_en: My patent covers fire-engines of every kind — that sentence saved me thirty years of royalties in court, and cost the laboratory sixteen years of progress.
key_concepts: 垄断租 monopoly rent（特许费占利润大头——制造退居下游）
续期博弈 the extension game（议会游说把 14 年延至 35 年——产权政治化）
压制外部性 the suppression externality（高压路线被冻结——专利的社会成本）
process_zh: 把核心原理而非具体机器写成专利：'分离冷凝器'这个原理层面覆盖一切可能实现——原理专利比产品专利宽得多
争取续期：以已投入成本与尚未回收为据，推动议会把专利延至 1800 年——产权的第一次增值
设计收租结构：拒发许可证+按省煤三分之一收费+每马力年费——特许费成为利润主体，制造外包
以诉讼执行垄断：对霍恩布洛尔、布尔逐一起诉并胜诉——法律执行成为商业模式的一部分
process_en: Patent the principle, not the machine: 'the separate condenser' at principle level covers every implementation — a principle patent is far wider than a product patent
Fight for the extension: citing sunk costs and unrecouped investment, have Parliament extend the patent to 1800 — the property's first appreciation
Design the rent structure: licences refused, a royalty of one third the fuel saved, £5 per horsepower per year — royalties become the profit centre, manufacturing outsourced
Enforce the monopoly by litigation: sue Hornblower, then Bull, and win — legal enforcement becomes part of the business model
representative_cases_zh: 1775 年专利延长：专利从 14 年延至 35 年（1769+1800）——博尔顿的议会关系直接变成资产负债表
1799 年霍恩布洛尔案胜诉：复合机被判侵权（因用了分离冷凝器），霍恩布洛尔赔款并退出——复合机路线被压制到专利期满
专利期满后的对手反应：特里维西克高压机、伍尔夫复合机在 1800-1804 年集中涌现——被冻结的创新在解冻后五倍提速
representative_cases_en: The 1775 extension: the patent stretched from fourteen to thirty-five years (1769 to 1800) — Boulton's parliamentary connections converted directly into balance-sheet value
The 1799 victory over Hornblower: the compound engine ruled infringing for using a separate condenser; Hornblower paid damages and exited — the compound line suppressed until the patent lapsed
The rivals' response after expiry: Trevithick's high-pressure and Woolf's compound engines crowded in during 1800-1804 — innovation frozen inside the patent ran five times faster the moment it thawed
modern_applications_zh: 专利丛林与标准必要专利诉讼：以原理级权利要求+续期+诉讼的组合构筑护城河（及其被反垄断审查的现代对照）
开源双许可：核心闭源收费+周边开源——现代版的'拒发许可证'
平台抽成模式：应用商店 30% 抽成=按'省下的分发成本'收租——收租模式的当代形态及其监管反噬
modern_applications_en: Patent thickets and SEP litigation: principle-level claims plus renewal plus suits as a moat (and their modern antitrust counterweight)
Dual licensing: core closed-source paid, periphery open — the modern refusal to license
Platform take rates: an app-store 30% cut as rent on 'distribution saved' — the rent model's current form and its regulatory backlash

modes.domain_zh: 商业方法论/以能力互补的合伙结构补齐发明家的致命短板
modes.domain_en: Business methodology / completing the inventor's fatal gaps with a partnership of complementary capabilities
modes.definition_zh: 创业方法论/发明家的典型死法是'死在没人补位的环节上'——瓦特两次几乎死于不同短板：与罗巴克合作时死于资金链与加工精度（罗巴克有钱但镗不出缸，1773 年破产）；他自己致命的短板是忧郁、债务与经营——博尔顿的补位是全方位的：钱（买下罗巴克份额）、厂（Soho 工厂与熟练工匠）、势（议会关系促成专利延长）、市场眼光（'我的机器不只抽水，它要给全世界的工厂做动力'）；分工上瓦特管技术、博尔顿管经营与外交——他写信给博尔顿：'你能卖出去的东西我都能造出来'——互补不是性格互补，是价值链各环节的能力覆盖
modes.definition_en: Startup methodology: the typical death of an inventor is dying in an uncovered link — Watt nearly died twice of different gaps: with Roebuck he was killed by the funding chain and machining precision (Roebuck had money but could not bore a cylinder; bankruptcy in 1773); his own fatal gaps were melancholia, debt and management — Boulton's cover was total: money (buying out Roebuck's share), plant (the Soho works and its craftsmen), power (parliamentary connections that won the extension), and market vision ('my machines are not for pumping water only — they will drive the mills of the world'); the division of labour: Watt technology, Boulton commerce and diplomacy — Watt wrote to him, 'whatever you can sell, I can make' — complementarity is not temperament but coverage of every link of the value chain
modes.source_chapter: 瓦特致博尔顿书信（'It is incomparably better than any... the selling part will give you infinitely less trouble than the making'）；罗巴克破产与份额转让记录
modes.key_quote_zh: 罗巴克能付钱，付不出精度；我能画图，画不出市场——博尔顿说'我来卖'，于是这桩事业第一次三样俱全。
modes.key_quote_en: Roebuck could pay but not bore; I could draw but not sell — Boulton said 'I will sell', and for the first time the venture had all three.
key_concepts: 短板清单 the gap list（资金/工艺/渠道/法律逐项核查由谁覆盖）
能力交换能力 capability exchange（'你卖我造'的显式分工）
双重验证 dual endorsement（技术判断与商业判断各有一票否决）
process_zh: 给项目列'致命短板清单'：资金、工艺、渠道、法律、组织——逐项标注'已有/无人'
按短板而不是按好感选合伙人：博尔顿入选是因为厂、钱、势、市场四项全占，而非谈得来
显式分工并写进协议：瓦特管设计与技术改进，博尔顿管销售、工厂与议会——分工落到书信与合同
在短板复发时二次补位：1800 年前后由子辈接手管理（瓦特之子、博尔顿之子），把'人'的补位制度化
process_en: List the project's fatal gaps: money, process, channel, law, organisation — tag each as covered or uncovered
Choose partners by gap, not by chemistry: Boulton made the cut because he covered plant, money, power and market, not because he was agreeable
Divide explicitly and write it down: Watt designs and improves; Boulton sells, runs the factory and works Parliament — division made binding in letters and contract
Re-cover gaps as they recur: around 1800 the sons (Watt Jr., Boulton Jr.) took over management — institutionalising the human cover
representative_cases_zh: 罗巴克失败的教训 (1769-1773)：资金+精度双缺——瓦特本人做运河测量员糊口，'发明是天下最蠢的事'出自这一时期的绝望
博尔顿入局 (1773-1775)：买下罗巴克份额、提供 Soho 工厂、促成议会延长专利——三条致命短板一次补齐
威尔金森+博尔顿+瓦特三角：工艺（威尔金森）、市场与厂（博尔顿）、设计与计量（瓦特）——价值链每环各有其主
representative_cases_en: The Roebuck lesson (1769-73): money and precision both missing — Watt surveyed canals to feed his family; 'of all things in life there is nothing more foolish than inventing' dates from this despair
Boulton's entry (1773-75): buying Roebuck's share, providing the Soho works, winning the parliamentary extension — three fatal gaps closed at once
The Wilkinson-Boulton-Watt triangle: process (Wilkinson), market and plant (Boulton), design and metrology (Watt) — every link of the value chain with an owner
modern_applications_zh: 创始人互补配置：技术 CEO+商业 COO 的经典结构——先列短板清单再找人
产学研合作：大学出原理、企业出工艺与渠道——瓦特-布莱克-博尔顿结构的高校版
风投增值服务：钱之外补董事会、招募、法务——现代博尔顿主义
modern_applications_en: Complementary founding teams: the classic technical CEO and commercial COO — list the gaps first, then recruit
Industry-academia collaboration: universities supply principle, firms supply process and channel — the Watt-Black-Boulton structure on campus
Venture value-add services: beyond money, board seats, recruiting, legal — Boultonism, modern edition

modes.domain_zh: 成长方法论/功成名就后主动把方法迁移到全新领域保持创造力
modes.domain_en: Growth methodology / after success, laterally migrating one's methods to wholly new fields to stay creative
modes.definition_zh: 职业发展方法论/巅峰成就完成后不恋战原领域，而是把已练成的方法论整体搬运到陌生领域：1800 年专利期满、从公司退休后，64 岁的瓦特没有在蒸汽机里寻找第二春，而是在汉兹沃思家中的阁楼工作室里横移：雕塑复制车床（把蒸汽机上练出的精密传动用于艺术复制）、改进的干式测湿仪、继续改良复制机——蒸汽机的原理一步不再碰，但'精密传动+仪器化测量+批量复制'这套方法论原封不动地搬了家；他与萨瑟恩的指示图、与默多克的关系都以'方法的传承'而非'机器的复制'延续——创造力以方法为单位迁移，不以产品为单位延续
modes.definition_en: Career methodology: after the crowning achievement, do not linger in the old field — carry the whole trained methodology laterally into strange territory: when the patent lapsed and he retired in 1800, the 64-year-old Watt sought no second spring in steam; in the garret workshop of his Handsworth house he migrated sideways: a sculpture-copying lathe (precision transmission, trained on engines, turned to art reproduction), an improved dry hygrometer, further refinements of the copying press — not one more principle of the steam engine, but the methodology of 'precision transmission + instrumented measurement + batch replication' moved house intact; his ties to Southern's indicator and to Murdoch continued as transmission of method, not copies of machines — creativity migrates by methodology, not by product line
modes.source_chapter: 汉兹沃思阁楼工作室遗物（伯明翰科学博物馆藏）；晚年雕塑复制车床与测湿仪记录
modes.key_quote_zh: 蒸汽机的专利到期了，但'精密传动、仪器测量、批量复制'这三样手艺不过期——我把它们搬上阁楼，去干别的。
modes.key_quote_en: The engine patent expired, but the three crafts of precision transmission, instrumented measurement and batch replication did not — I carried them up to the garret and set them to other work.
key_concepts: 方法论迁移 method migration（手艺过领域，产品不过领域）
阁楼工作室 the garret workshop（退休不是停止发明，是更换应用域）
传承即交接 transmission as handover（以方法的延续代替机器的重复）
process_zh: 盘点巅峰期练成的'可迁移手艺'：精密传动、仪器化测量、批量复制——列出脱离原领域依然成立的技能
选定方法密度高的新领域：艺术复制、气象测量、办公自动化——哪里更需要这些手艺就去哪里
在新领域做最小作品而非宏伟计划：阁楼里的车床与测湿仪都是单件作品——先证明方法在新域可用
把方法而非机器传给下一代：与克鲁格式的人物（默多克、萨瑟恩、子辈）交接的是方法论脉络
process_en: Inventory the transferable crafts honed at the peak: precision transmission, instrumented measurement, batch replication — skills that survive outside the old field
Pick a new field dense in those methods: art reproduction, meteorological measurement, office automation — go where the crafts are scarcest
Make minimal works, not grand plans, in the new field: the garret lathe and hygrometer are single pieces — prove the method travels before scaling
Hand down the method, not the machine: to Murdoch, Southern and the sons goes the methodological lineage, not a duplicator of engines
representative_cases_zh: 雕塑复制车床 (1800s)：把蒸汽机的精密传动用于复制肖像与雕塑——潘多夫尼与巴贝奇都参观过这套装置
改进干式测湿仪：以仪器化测量手艺改进气象仪器——测量方法论从汽缸移到空气
复制机与化学实验的持续改良：办公自动化与化学是他退休后仍在推进的两条线——复制与测量的老手艺换了应用域
representative_cases_en: The sculpture-copying lathe (1800s): the engine's precision transmission set to reproducing portraits and sculpture — Pandolfi and Babbage both came to see it
The improved dry hygrometer: the instrumented-measurement craft applied to weather instruments — metrology moving from cylinder to air
The copying press and chemistry kept improving: office automation and chemistry were the two lines he pushed in retirement — old crafts of copying and measuring in new domains
modern_applications_zh: 技术高管转型：系统性方法论（架构/度量/规模化）迁移到投资、教育、气候等新域
实验室转型：把'实验设计+仪器化'方法用于生物、材料等相邻领域而非原地迭代
个人职业第二曲线：以'可迁移技能清单'为起点规划转型，而非从行业头衔出发
modern_applications_en: Executive transition: migrating a systematic methodology (architecture, measurement, scaling) into investing, education or climate
Laboratory pivots: carrying 'experimental design plus instrumentation' into biology or materials rather than iterating in place
A personal second curve: plan the pivot from a list of transferable skills, not from a job title
